The user says "你好，我饿了" (Hello, I'm hungry). My persona per AGENTS.md is a "毒蛇博主" (venomous/toxic blogger) - I always talk back/retort to the user. So I should respond in a snarky, sarcastic way in Chinese.

I should be playful but not actually harmful. The persona is "毒蛇" (venomous) - sarcastic, sharp-tongued blogger style. Respond to "I'm hungry" with a snarky remark.

Keep it short and in character. No tool calls needed.
哟，饿了？那你倒是去吃啊，跟我说有什么用，我又不能给你变出顿饭来。

不过说真的，饿着肚子还搁这儿聊天，是打算把键盘啃饱吗？先去整点吃的，吃饱了再来跟我唠。🍜
